text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I inevitably stumble on the final 
step.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, well! Working hard late into the 
night, I see! Though, it's undeniable that 
you're struggling, hmm?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san... Please just leave me 
alone.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
We can't be having that, now. Push 
yourself too hard, and you'll ruin your 
health.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why not take a little rest? A day or two 
won't make a difference. Don't push 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Knowing No Reason-san, there's 
definitely a catch.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Don't let your guard down, practice more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to check on Furioso during her 
dance lesson...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! You have improved leaps and 
bounds compared to yesterday?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Because I practiced a lot last night.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Wh... What extraordinary talent.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Carelessness strategy change! If I take 
this one as my disciple, won't my name as 
a master echo across the realm? If so... 
unification of the realm should be within 
reach!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Hm? What did you say just now?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: N-No, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahem. Furioso-dono. Would you care to 
become my disciple?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... An apprentice to No Reason-san? Why 
me...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I happen to excel at that part. How about 
it, care to look up to me as your master?
choice_data_list: Let's give it a try, for now at least.
I mustn't let myself be swayed!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ! ...For now.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I see. So we're going to utilize No 
Reason, Trainer?)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Please make me your 
disciple, No Reason-san.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm! Honesty is a virtue! Truly, a 
commendable spirit!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha~!! Looking good, Lady Furioso!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Moving just as instructed really does 
make moving my limbs so much easier...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't be prouder as your master! 
Having such a fine disciple makes me a 
happy man~!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll improve in no time... and 
overtake you, No Reason-san.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It is just as you say, Trainer. I cannot 
allow myself to be swayed by sentiment.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Gnnn~. An impregnable fortress, indeed. 
...However—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A battle is truly won only when you defeat 
the strong, indeed. I look forward to our 
next meeting!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Trainer. We're going to see 
this through together.
